lines.t: Headlights cut through
The black plains of night
Eighteen wheels hum soft
Under the sky
picked up a stranger on the side of the road he smiled and said man are you ready to know
he talked about signs and the days ahead said truth's been written but the world's gone dead
I kept one hand steady, one ear on his tongue
As the desert wind whispered, we're not alone
He said, awake my brother, judgment has come
The banner of truth is brighter than the sun
The trumpet's calling, don't be caught asleep
It's light for the lost and strength for the weak
He looked at me with fire in his eyes
Said the dawn is coming to the midnight skies
And I felt the weight of miles and grace
Rolling through the dark with a holy face
Restop coffee, rain on the glass
The words kept burning, they wouldn't pass
He spoke mercy like thunder on stone
Of hearts made new and a king on his throne
My rig kept rolling
My house felt like tears
But something inside
Cut through the years
I thought I was hauling freight tonight
But I was hauling truth into the light
He said, awake my brother, judgment has come
The banner of truth is brighter than the sun
The trumpet's calling, don't be caught asleep
There's light for the lost and strength for the weak
He looked at me with fire in his eyes
Said the dawn is coming to the midnight skies
And I felt the weight of miles and grace
Rolling through the dark with a holy face
And by the time we hit the mountain lion
He vanished like a ghost
But the words stayed mine
Hold fast to love, don't turn away
Awake, the day of the Lord is the break of day.
Awake, my brother, judgment has come.
The banner of truth, still bright as the sun.
Now I drive these roads with faith that speaks.
There's hope for the lost and strength for the weak
If you ask me what I've found
I'll tell you truth rides every town to town
And every mile and every prayer
The voice of the volumes is still out there
Still out there
